offense_title_full: Negligently Causes Bodily Injury to the Sports Official with a Weapon
offense_title_short: Negligently Causes Bodily Injury with Weapon
offense_display_full: Assault Upon Sports Official - Negligently Causes Bodily Injury to the Sports Official with a Weapon
offense_display_short: Assault - Sports Official - Negligently Causes Bodily Injury with Weapon
description: A person commits the offense of assault upon a sports official if, while a sports official is acting as an official at an athletic contest in any sport at any level of amateur or professional competition, the person negligently causes bodily injury to the sports official with a weapon.
